Summary: Evaluate PPP forecasts with strictly lagged predictors and untouched time holdouts
Description:
As an analyst, I want PPP forecasting evaluated using only information available before the prediction time and untouched later observations, so forecast claims are supported by prospective-style evidence.

Follow-up to [SCRUM-476](https://basketball-strategy.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-476). The current calibration report uses a fixed Ridge configuration and separate earlier-season training/later-season evaluation rows, but includes retrospective same-season rate statistics. Its results do not establish pre-game forecasting accuracy. This enhancement is outside the current calibration-display implementation.

Acceptance criteria:

* Define the prediction timestamp and target horizon; document each predictor's availability time.
* Build strictly lagged predictors without using held-out outcomes or statistics computed from future games/seasons.
* Freeze an untouched chronological holdout; use only earlier data for feature selection, scaling and model/hyperparameter choice.
* Compare an eligible baseline and forecast model on the same untouched observations; report error and calibration with sample counts and limitations.
* Add leakage/availability tests proving that changing future observations cannot change earlier prediction inputs or training-fitted transformations.
* Document the evaluation protocol and source/data version so the results can be reproduced.

Planning estimate: 3 story points, not time spent. Planned for the existing future Iteration-15 (sprint 183, October 6–12, 2026 local time). No implementation or completed validation is claimed by creation.
